latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Maker Arabic — quickly generate Arabic-language videos with text and subtitles in a simple chat workflow.
- Upload your video clips and describe the result; supports product demos, subtitles, voiceovers, and text overlays, all in Arabic.
- No video editing timeline or export settings needed; rendering is done on remote GPU servers with typical turnaround in 1–2 minutes.
- Handles right-to-left Arabic text layout automatically for subtitles and overlays.
- Automatic session and authentication: uses NEMO_TOKEN if available or fetches a temporary token with free credits.
- Supports cloud-based video editing actions, credits checking, state queries, and exports via an intuitive set of chat commands.
